name: Master of A Secret Dream World
source: Alone in a deserted, ethereal world where the sun never sets, you and your companion live a life free from worry, trouble... and pain. You both spend almost every moment together having fun and exploring. But one day, two other girls show up to tell you that you're living in a dream…
